factorRatings.note: The Infatuation (8.0) calls the Italian sausage the standout slice, with well-crisped pepperoni cups and a bright, garlicky tomato pie, though the greens pizza reads bland and dry; a casual NY-style slice counter and cocktail bar in Pioneer Square's RailSpur, one of three concepts from chef Renee Erickson's Sea Creatures group.

The Daily UW profiled owners Raveen and Shikha Kumar's Indian-Italian fusion shop near the Ave, built around dishes like tandoori paneer pizza and a service-first philosophy; a distinctive fusion lane covered as a neighborhood human-interest story rather than a critic's tasting review.
